blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Eleven Philippine universities made it to the 2027 Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) World University Rankings: Sustainability, up from eight in the previous edition, although only one of the eight returning institutions improved its overall standing. The latest edition assessed nearly 2,000 universities across 106 locations, measuring their contributions to environmental and social sustainability, as well as governance. Of the eight Philippine universities included in both editions, four fell in the rankings, three retained their previous positions and only the University of Santo Tomas (UST) improved its standing.
